rows.role_title: رئيس مجلس الشورى — Chairman of the Shura Council
rows.text: Royal Order A/13 dated 19/2/1430 AH, issued by King Abdullah bin Abdulaziz: item First relieves 'معالي الشيخ الدكتور عبدالله بن محمد بن إبراهيم آل الشيخ' of his post as Minister of Justice and appoints him Chairman of the Shura Council with the rank of minister.

rows.text: Item First of the same order closes 'اعتباراً من 3/3/1430هـ' (with effect from 3/3/1430 AH), an effective day that covers the whole sentence: the relief from the Justice portfolio and the appointment as Chairman.
